declarations.name: VeraTabs
declarations.description: Tabs over the author's own buttons and panels: a direct child marked slot="tabs" holds the buttons, the host's other children are the panels. Before the script runs they are buttons and sections; after it, the roles, ids and aria wiring are set, the arrow keys move one tab stop, one panel shows, and an indicator under the selected tab follows it by CSS anchor positioning. A user's selection fires a cancelable beforetabchange, then tabchange.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The selected tab's key (its value attribute, else its position). Reflects the selection; writing it selects that tab and fires nothing. Observed.

attributes.name: activation
attributes.description: "manual": the arrow keys move focus only, and Enter or Space selects. Otherwise an arrow key selects the tab it reaches. Observed, and read at each key.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: "vertical": the tablist is a column and Up and Down move. Default horizontal. Observed.

attributes.name: findable
attributes.description: "false": inactive panels are plain hidden. Otherwise they are hidden="until-found" where the engine has it, so find-in-page reaches them and selects their tab. Observed.

events.name: beforetabchange

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value: string, previous: string | null, reason: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' | 'find' }>

events.description: Before a user selection, on the host, bubbling. Cancelable, except when find-in-page already revealed the panel.

events.name: tabchange

type.text: CustomEvent<{ value: string, previous: string | null, reason: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' | 'find' | 'disabled' }>

events.description: After a user's selection, or after the selected tab was disabled and the next one took over; on the host, bubbling. A write to value fires nothing.

slots.name: tabs
slots.description: A direct child marked slot="tabs" is the tablist, holding the author's <button>s. Nothing is distributed: it stays where it was written.

cssParts.name: tablist
cssParts.description: The author's slot="tabs" container, marked data-vera-part="tablist": its ::after is the indicator under the selected tab.
